def place_on_zone_v1(obj_name, zone_name):
    obs = observe()
    obj = obs["objects"][obj_name]
    zone = obs["zones"][zone_name]

    # Check if zone is occupied
    occupied = False
    zone_half_size = zone["half_size"]
    zone_center = zone["center"]
    for o_name, o in obs["objects"].items():
        if (abs(o["center"][0] - zone_center[0]) < zone_half_size[0] + 0.01 and
            abs(o["center"][1] - zone_center[1]) < zone_half_size[1] + 0.01 and
            o["top_z"] < zone_center[2] + 0.01):
            if o_name != obj_name:  # don't count the target object
                occupied = True
                break

    if occupied:
        # Find a free alternative zone (e.g., purple_box) to clear the current zone
        # Assume purple_box is the only other candidate for clearing
        purple_box_name = "purple_box"
        if purple_box_name in obs["zones"]:
            purple_box = obs["zones"][purple_box_name]
            purple_box_occupied = False
            purple_box_half_size = purple_box["half_size"]
            purple_box_center = purple_box["center"]
            for o_name, o in obs["objects"].items():
                if (abs(o["center"][0] - purple_box_center[0]) < purple_box_half_size[0] + 0.01 and
                    abs(o["center"][1] - purple_box_center[1]) < purple_box_half_size[1] + 0.01 and
                    o["top_z"] < purple_box_center[2] + 0.01):
                    purple_box_occupied = True
                    break

            if not purple_box_occupied:
                # Move any object on the zone (except the target) to purple_box
                for o_name, o in obs["objects"].items():
                    if (abs(o["center"][0] - zone_center[0]) < zone_half_size[0] + 0.01 and
                        abs(o["center"][1] - zone_center[1]) < zone_half_size[1] + 0.01 and
                        o["top_z"] < zone_center[2] + 0.01 and o_name != obj_name):
                        pick(o_name, 0.02, o["long_axis_yaw"])
                        place(purple_box_name)
                        break

    # Now place the target object on the zone
    pick(obj_name, 0.02, obj["long_axis_yaw"])
    place(zone_name)
skills.expected_effect: object resting inside the zone footprint, gripper open, arm lifted

conditions.notes: Assumes a single alternative zone (purple_box) is available for clearing; works when target object is not already on the zone.

       obj["center"][1] > orange_tray["center"][1] - orange_tray["half_size"][1] and \
       obj["top_z"] < orange_tray["center"][2] + 0.01:  # within tray height tolerance
        occupied = True
        break

if occupied:
    # Clear the tray using purple_box if available and unoccupied
    purple_box = obs["zones"]["purple_box"]
    purple_box_occupied = False
    for obj_name, obj in obs["objects"].items():
        if obj["center"][0] < purple_box["center"][0] + purple_box["half_size"][0] and \
           obj["center"][0] > purple_box["center"][0] - purple_box["half_size"][0] and \

           obj["top_z"] < purple_box["center"][2] + 0.01:
            purple_box_occupied = True
            break

    if not purple_box_occupied:
        # Move any object on orange_tray to purple_box
        for obj_name, obj in obs["objects"].items():

                # Pick and place on purple_box
                pick(obj_name, 0.02, obj["long_axis_yaw"])
                place("purple_box")
                break

# Now place red_block on orange_tray

def place_on_zone_v2(obj_name, zone_name):
    # Observe the current state to find the object and zone
    observation = observe()
    
    # Find the object in the scene
    obj = next((item for item in observation['objects'] if item['name'] == obj_name), None)
    if not obj:
        raise ValueError(f"Object {obj_name} not found in the scene.")
    
    # Find the zone in the scene
    zone = next((item for item in observation['zones'] if item['name'] == zone_name), None)
    if not zone:
        raise ValueError(f"Zone {zone_name} not found in the scene.")
    
    # Extract object and zone positions
    obj_pos = obj['position']
    zone_pos = zone['position']
    
    # Compute offset for placing the object on the zone (adjust based on object size and desired placement)
    # Use a small offset to center the object on the zone
    offset_x = zone_pos[0] - obj_pos[0]
    offset_y = zone_pos[1] - obj_pos[1]
    offset_z = zone_pos[2] + 0.02  # Slight lift above zone surface for safe placement
    
    # Pick the object with a safe approach height
    pick(obj_name, offset_x, offset_y, offset_z)
    
    # Place the object directly on the zone
    place(zone_name)
skills.expected_effect: object resting inside the zone footprint, gripper open, arm lifted

conditions.notes: The function assumes the object is graspable and the zone is accessible and free for placement.
